summaryPoints: Darius Fulghum tells World Boxing News how personal struggles and a difficult 2025 forced him to move camp before facing Diego Pacheco.

image.alt: Benavidez Maps Road to Usyk’s Undisputed Cruiserweight Shot

summaryPoints: David Benavidez outlines his route to all four cruiserweight belts before a potential September 2027 showdown with Oleksandr Usyk for undisputed.
Benavidez has confirmed discussions with Usyk about returning to 200 pounds, but first needs to collect the two remaining world titles.
That gives his December 5 fight with Michal Cieslak extra importance and places Jai Opetaia’s ongoing IBF dispute at the center of his plans.
